stt: Ask HN: What are your favorite books of all time, and why?
x:
* Johnny Got His Gun, by Dalton Trumbo. Powerful anti-war story.
  * Vagabonding, by Rolf Potts. Shaped my views on hard work and travel.
  * 1984, by George Orwell. Brilliant and terrifying.
  * The Power of Now, by Eckhart Tolle. Overcoming mental pain through consciousness. 
  * Planetwalker, by John Francis. Inspired me to walk and put myself into things more.
  * Pure enjoyment: Snow Crash (Neal Stephenson), Ready Player One (Ernest Cline), Watchmen (Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons), Red Rising trilogy (Pierce Brown).

Honorable mention: The Water Knife (Paolo Bacigalupi).

stt: Ask HN: What is your favorite piece of entertainment of the last three years?
x:
I like to follow a thematic thread with books and movies. Here are a few recent ones that might interest the HN crowd:

*  water issues/climate change in the Southwest:

  - *Chinatown* (film)
 
  - *The Water Knife* by Paolo Bacigalupi (sci-fi novel, described as "*Chinatown* meets *Mad Max*)

  - *The Cadillac Desert* by Marc Reisser (nonfiction, part of a plot element in *The Water Knife*

  - *Cadillac Desert* PBS documentary[1]

* Dark espionage thrillers:

  - *The Night Manager* by John LeCarre (novel, honestly not one of his best)

  - *The Night Manager* (TV miniseries--much better than the book!)

  - *The Ghost Writer* by Robert Harris (novel)

  - *The Ghost Writer* (movie)

  - *An Officer and a Spy* by Robert Harris (excellent and extensively researched historical novel, based on the Dreyfus Affair in Paris circa 1900)

  - *J'Accuse (An Officer and a Spy)* (movie)


[1]: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hkbebOhnCjA

Paolo Bacigalupi is fantastic if you're into eco-disaster sci-fi.   The Water Knife[1] is also excellent, and with the extreme drought in the western US, feeling more and more prescient.

1 - https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/23209924-the-water-knife

Ooooh if we're doing climate change novels allow me to add 1) almost anything by Paolo Bacigalupi and 2) two of Kim Stanley Robinson's latest three novels

1. PG short story The Tamarisk Hunter audio and text. What if federalism broke down and California paid a water bounty to keep the Colorado river flowing to CA. https://escapepod.org/2013/02/21/ep384-the-tamarisk-hunter/ canonical author's link: https://windupstories.com/books/pump-six-and-other-stories/t...

2. PG novel The Water Knife expanding on The Tamarisk Hunter https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/23209924-the-water-knife...

3. KSR novel New York 2140. What if sea rise into the cities led to a financial market on real estate involving day trading on those values? https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/29570143-new-york-2140?r...

4. KSR novel Ministry for the Future. What if the UN had to put together a team to keep the earth habitable as heatwaves started causing mass casualty events particularly in the subcontinent? https://www.goodreads.com/book/show/50998056-the-ministry-fo...
